question: Do non-stimulated young/active and old/sedentary muscle-chip flight-minus-ground directions recur from GSE234465 to GSE298393?
cohort: All 12 later-flight No E-stim Day21 samples, three chips per condition per donor pool; no stimulated or Day2 arms. Original 12 samples reused from completed survey.
model: Same frozen r7hnr92k and official pinned source; final gene mean and std, mask missing with -10; human mask/zero sensitivity.
preprocessing: Follow declared FPKM source units and rescale observed canonical FPKM to TPM; log1p once. Source lengths differ from first-flight counts/exon-length preprocessing; interpretation conditional on annotation.
checks: Within-pool cross-flight response cosine for raw expression and model summaries
interpretation: No significance or causal claims; shared cell pools are not independent donors; raw comparator required; report non-replication as well as agreement.
